fictionalFilter.rule: Drop clubs (club_team_id) where at least half the squad is born on 29 February, and clubless players born on 29 February.

fm.databaseDateNote: Release date of the FM26 26.3.0 data update; fetchedAt is only the retrieval time.
fm.ratingScale: 1-100 normalized Current Ability displayed by EFEM.club
fm.ratingNote: This is the source's displayed Current Ability, not raw FM 1-200 CA and not EFEM Score or potential. Preserve it without dividing again.
fm.selection: Up to 100 highest Current Ability male players per map nation; exact primary nationality code; known natural position; no inferred identity or ratings.
fm.identityNote: Names are the database display names. The public Default view does not expose date of birth or EA player IDs.

identity.rule: Person key: the Reep id (scripts/data/reep-bridge.json), else a football-identity-overrides.json entry, else the name matcher between records no key pairs yet and no Reep person keeps apart (within a nation by name, then across nations by full name), always with FM's age within a year of the EA birth date, one-to-one; an FM name of one word never joins (FM records carry no birth date). A person with no Reep id is keyed by its EA record id, else its FM record id.

ea.name: Igor Julio
ea.fullName: Igor Julio dos Santos de Paulo

nationArbitrationRule: Each person enters exactly one nation's pool before any XI is picked. When its records name different nations, the first rule that applies decides. (a) override: a nations entry of scripts/data/football-identity-overrides.json, checked by hand against the person's senior caps. (b) fresher-ea / fresher-fm: the nationality of the source dated later; EA's when its snapshot postdates the FM database (EA FC 27 of 2026-11-01 against FM 26 26.3.0 of 2026-03-30), else FM's primary nationality. (c) ea-nationality: otherwise (several EA or several FM nations) the best-rated EA record's nationality, or with no EA record the best-rated FM record's. A person whose chosen nation is off the map (Scotland, Wales) enters no pool. The person keeps one record in the pool, EA first, whatever nation won.
